## Why it matters

This KITLV collection at Leiden University Libraries contains photographs, prints, and drawings on Southeast Asia and the Caribbean, much of it documenting the colonial period.

It supports visual and colonial history research with browsable image records, while also pointing users to fuller catalogue descriptions where available.
